scope: Follow-up runtime verification after v1.2.23 publication

standard_prop_dynamic_flex.conclusion: The standard prop_dynamic path cannot consume vertex flex weights through this L4D2 VScript entity class.

l4d2.cleanup: Task-owned models, materials, scripts and configuration were removed and game settings restored.

insurgency.reason: The prior isolated run reached contact but had no reliable model readback; this follow-up prioritized the actionable L4D2 consumer contract.

ce_replacemesh.conclusion: The changelog mention has no public syntax, source implementation, issue example or release asset. An alias would be invented compatibility.

limits: This proves L4D2 bodygroup consumption for mesh states, not a GMod Lua consumer or arbitrary flex playback.
A flex-capable CBaseFlex entity, an engine extension, or a different runtime consumer is required for L4D2 vertex animation playback.
